data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 net technical result of GBP 24.0m (2014: GBP 48.6m) includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims development on prior years produced a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 8.6m (gross), driven by increases in older accident years (notably 2011) partly offset by favourable development on other prior years. The report however states a net release of GBP 29.0m after reinsurance recoveries. Exchange rate movements and significant reinsurance recoveries appear to have materially affected the net outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years
Effect of movements in exchange rates

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) on page 43 (figures are presented in GBP 000). The report text quotes a net release of GBP 29.0m (after reinsurance) - the gross triangle indicates a net adverse movement of +GBP 8.592m. No separate explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure was printed; net and gross differ materially (likely due to reinsurance recoveries and FX movements).
